definitions.explanation: Something that has just been made or prepared, implying it is at its freshest or best state. Used especially for food, but also for other crafted items.

examples.japanese: {作|つく}りたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧おいしい。
{作|つく}りたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: They served me a freshly prepared dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{作|つく}りたてだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: This tofu is freshly made, so the taste is completely different.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make) + たて (just done). The たて suffix attaches to the stem of verbs to mean "just [verb]ed" and implies the result is still in its freshest or most desirable state.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {作|つく}りたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧: freshly baked bread
- {作|つく}りたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: freshly prepared food
- {作|つく}りたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧: a freshly made bento

OTHER WORDS WITH たて:
- ⟦{焼|や}きたて→焼きたて：16735_yakitate⟧: freshly baked/grilled
- {炊|た}きたて: freshly cooked (rice)
- ⟦{揚|あ}げたて→揚げたて：16736_agetate⟧: freshly deep-fried
- {出来|でき}たて: just completed/ready

USAGE:
Typically used with the particle ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to modify a noun: {作|つく}りたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧＋noun. Very common in food contexts, where freshness is a selling point. Signs at bakeries and restaurants often advertise {作|つく}りたて items.
